title: Transfer - Pump Station Overflow Risk Report
goal: Evaluate 15-minute wet-well level readings for pump stations against station-specific overflow thresholds, aggregate to daily maxima, and write `/root/output/pump_station_overflow_report.csv` for stations with at least one overflow-risk day, including overflow-day counts and first overflow date.
skillBenefitRationale: The scenario moves into wastewater utility monitoring, but the underlying problem is still threshold-based flood event detection over time-series level data. Success depends on the same aggregation and threshold-crossing logic, making flood-detection the only essential shipped skill.
